messages.subject: [R-sig-DCM] PPCE In R
messages.body_plain:
Hi.  I am looking for an efficient way to program a partial profile conjoint
experiment in R.  I am just beginning my search for this information, so any
insight you could provide would be most helpful.  For context, I am
experienced using AlgDesign to create full profile, D-optimal blocked
designs.  Its the PPCE designs where I could use some advice.

Thanks so much.

John
